question: The goal changed mid-build. Update the frozen spec and re-freeze, or keep it as-is?
context: Spec site-map-capability.followups.spec (docs/specs/site-map-capability.followups.spec.md). The frozen spec source changed since it was frozen — the goal may have moved. Confirm the new goal before more is built on the old one.

options.label: Take the new goal
options.one_line_preview: If you pick this, we will update docs/specs/site-map-capability.followups.spec.md to the new goal and re-freeze it.
options.trade_off: You give up: the first frozen goal, so the new one becomes the bar.

options.label: Keep the current spec
options.one_line_preview: If you pick this, we will keep building to the spec already frozen.
options.trade_off: You give up: capturing the new goal, so the change waits.

recommendation_reason: A real goal change must update the spec and re-freeze before work continues.
rationale: Align FR-5/INV-3/AC-5 to the shipped ledger-audit curation (no journey decision-category exists); implementation honors the audited-human-sign-off intent.
